payload.title: How does hyp keep a text longer than a field's rune cap?
payload.body: Difference test on the issues' options. raise vs pin-file: no sentence; G-V5NP59#1 forbids a pinned text. raise vs keep: on e-hqwta0-650, raise meets G-V5NP59#1 and keep does not, because 600 refuses it and the stored retry drops c04-strict's reason; keep is the base. raise vs split: on g908prz-gate-1346, raise meets G-V5NP59#1 and split does not, because shared clauses (397) plus part 1 (290) and the base check (113) are 801 runes; split also combines with raise. derive and store block combine with raise: not rivals.

payload.body: Raise the caps the Goal body names and print raised fields whole in hyp show and the last checkpoint's summary whole in hyp status; replay checks the same caps. The base is the rival through red on base: it refuses every CASES draft at exit 1.
